comparison_templates.text: The lower-baseline option keeps the same arena and session, with a closer behind-the-court view; it may carry a higher modeled cost.
comparison_templates.condition: same arena/stage/session; alternative LB; hero UB; only mention higher cost when index gap >=3 and directional

comparison_templates.text: The upper-baseline option keeps the same arena and session, with an elevated behind-the-court view and potentially lower modeled cost.
comparison_templates.condition: same arena/stage/session; alternative UB; hero LB; cost claim only if supported

comparison_templates.text: Both options are closely matched; the main difference is the viewing angle, from behind the baseline versus a side-on perspective.
comparison_templates.condition: baseline vs sideline; especially exact ties; no superiority

comparison_templates.text: Margaret Court offers another substantial arena experience in a more contained setting than Rod Laver.
Rod Laver offers the tournament’s flagship big-stadium setting as an alternative to Margaret Court.
John Cain offers a lively, more intimate arena setting with a reserved seat; the precise seat location is not specified.
A Ground Pass emphasizes moving among eligible outside courts rather than holding a reserved arena seat.
comparison_templates.condition: GP vs reserved; never claim only GP permits grounds exploration

comparison_templates.condition: reserved vs GP; access subject to ticket terms
